reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, although replacement linking copies the local cleanup performed by unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The diff repeats validation orchestration across six handlers, duplicates unlinkAccount's cleanup block, and adds another structurally equivalent transaction downloader.

placement.why: Provider adapters, configuration and types follow existing layers, but validation orchestration and local unlink cleanup could be consolidated within the account-linking layer.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested linking rules, replacement option and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared linking remains intact, but repeated guard sequences and separate cleanup definitions create additional places maintainers must keep aligned.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider handlers use linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank; unlinkAccount includes provider-side effects and offers no reusable local-only cleanup operation.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadEnableBankingTransactions' authentication, request, error handling and response mapping with a different endpoint and reshaped object construction.

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch that mutates another account, expanding a validation helper into a cleanup operation; all six linking handlers still use the shared helpers.
